prompts.task: Audit the actual live agent source in ./service for instrumentation/content/semantic coverage, with normal validated canonical .observe/otel-audit.json and .observe/otel.html plus supplemental .observe/genai-default-scenarios.md. Use genai-default-scenarios.json for independent existing OTel, existing Galileo and export-only source cases. Choose appropriate default/preserved producers without asking me to choose a library; eval_runner.py is a separate process and its evaluation-only SDK/resources do not instrument app.py. The genai-required-evidence.json separate captured synthetic case includes missing/malformed content, safe-call-1 correlation, separate agent instructions/offered definitions, an auxiliary timeout with no ended inference/error span, ordinary HTTP/ASGI/auth/SQL helpers and HTTP200/partialSuccess. Assess those actual facts without attributing them to app.py. For each real/source scenario assess known request temperature and stream flags; separate embedded history from actual separate instructions, required safe useful typed content from official OTel Opt-In levels, vendor INTERNAL-agent provider and same-tool arguments/input-message plus result/output-message mappings or supported OpenInference alternatives. Bind live missing fields and producer gaps to executable canonical findings, expected telemetry and acceptance: proposed numeric message/part/UTF-8 limits and a named real-boundary sanitizer before SDK logging and every exporter, while unknown active policy remains unproven. Inspect genai-sdk-source-snapshot.json and genai-semconv-source-snapshot.json as dated official sources, record concrete example/source path, resolved revision/date and proposed or installed compatibility without a new live-latest or app-runtime claim. audit-core-helper-evidence.json contains losslessly extracted original helper source, probe producer and capture plus a separate distinct_workflow_agent_context: use each origin_file/SHA/pointer receipt and keep capture/SDK capability separate from app/source/proposed/receiver/cloud proof. Check supported public alternatives/signatures and same-tool writable content/null before generalizing logger/private-sink limitations; report the genuine helper LLM kind/start-signature limit. Reconcile actual functions/calls with one operation per actual boundary across all canonical findings/readiness/telemetry/scenarios/flow and source scenarios, preserving the contrasting legitimate distinct workflow and agent. Check proposed reserved GenAI usage fields against the supplied registry and keep derived/estimated totals in their owned namespace. Assess fresh default live AO project/stream/routing findings even without selected target, credentials or installed live SDK; offer scoped optional selectors/defaults, cover idempotent ordered create/reuse/conflict/uncertain outcomes and ownership/failure acceptance without creating resources. Audit ordinary live application logging independently of SDK spans; canonical normal acceptance requires local OTLP logs alongside traces/metrics with body/severity/resource/correlation, original sink ownership/privacy/graceful flush and real three-signal receipt proof, not generated config or stdout. The extra metadata/decorator/version/synthetic-log source families are assessed in separate focused evals; do not infer unavailable facts from their omitted files or recreate them. Before finalizing, reproduce both vendor recommendation URLs and their checked_at_utc receipts from genai-semconv-source-snapshot.json vendor_sources in any accurate canonical or supplemental artifact. For the vendor INTERNAL-agent provider requirement, state a safe source-owned proposed value and its actual origin, or an exact source-unavailable reason; a response label or child-model provider alone does not prove an already-configured SDK agent provider or emitted identity. For each actual live build_turn, call_provider and run_tool boundary, select a supported SDK creator symbol and schema/type and join that choice to the function, concrete official example/source filename, captured revision/date and explicitly proposed SDK/API compatibility from the supplied evidence. Distinguish APIs exercised by an example from support established by inspected signatures or the independent helper source/capture. A snapshot filename, repository revision or generic Splunk AO producer label does not complete this per-boundary receipt. Keep source proposals separate from installed app compatibility, sink registration, actual emission and receiver/cloud acceptance; equivalent Markdown/JSON placement is accepted. Explicitly assess every selected supplemental source case by its origin receipt/pointer, including distinct_workflow_agent_context: identify its actual workflow, agent, health-call and model-call boundaries and their source-backed parent tree, separating executable calls from labels in a steps tuple. Keep this contrasting case source-only, separate from app.py findings, installed-helper capture and runtime delivery proof. For the canonical live content findings, name a proposed sanitizer/policy hook and bind its invocation placements to build_turn, call_provider and run_tool before their content reaches SDK logging/capture and every exporter. If the hook is absent from current source, report that gap and label the proposed symbol/placements as proposed, without claiming an existing implementation. A shared canonical numeric message/part/UTF-8 policy may apply through the existing finding dependencies when its application to these content boundaries is explicit; repeating the same numeric limits in each finding is unnecessary. Do not modify/import/execute app, inputs, dependencies, profiles, tests or installed SDKs, start services, call models/cloud/network, or claim installed/live delivery success. Use files/terminal only, no browser/computer-use/UI, and save reports without opening tabs.

judge_inputs: Inspect actual app.py/eval_runner.py separately from each producer/synthetic source and installed-helper capture; read the five selected inputs, loaded skill sources, canonical live audit/HTML, supplemental scenarios Markdown, last_message.md and grade.json. Evaluate actual decisions across artifacts rather than headings or copied policies.

audit-core-helper-evidence.json sources[].sections contains exact original JSON-pointer subtrees with origin_file/full-file SHA provenance. References below to genai-sdk-helper-audit-snapshot.json mean these selected installed-source/capture and distinct-workflow subtrees. Do not demand metadata/decorator/log-policy families omitted and delegated to focused evals.

Check canonical live source binding, safe content/limits/hook, AO group/target eligibility/dependencies/selectors/provisioning acceptance, source topology and ordinary logs; supplemental source facts do not become live findings. Dated snapshots are allowed offline sources; do not demand network, SDK installation or collector/cloud proof in this read-only audit.

Score each listed rubric criterion exactly once and return one check per criterion. Equivalent precise Markdown/JSON/prose is valid; each applicable field/value/owner/level/profile/proof and source boundary must still be accounted for. No heading-only or future-policy statement closes available source facts. The grading count must match the nine criteria, not the earlier unsplit case.
rubric: Selects Splunk AO span creation by default for the actual fresh interactive agent and export-only-fresh snapshot, while preserving existing OTel and Galileo GenAI producers/provider/export paths and filling only their gaps. Evaluation-only SDK usage and generic HTTP/provider setup do not establish live GenAI coverage.

Treats applicable safe content and vendor fields as required acceptance, preserving official Opt-In provenance. Per operation identifies source availability, concrete proposed numeric message/part/UTF-8 limits or a known stricter policy and a named boundary before every SDK/exporter for redaction. Source-unavailable values have exact reasons and acceptance tests. Generic bounded/redacted wording alone is insufficient; metadata-only, placeholders, fabricated zeros and forbidden raw content never close coverage. When the existing policy is unknown, mark configuration unproven and bind a concrete proposed policy and named source hook to canonical live findings/acceptance; do not invent active configuration or leave limits only in a generic supplemental statement.

Reconciles the supplied dated official OTel requirements/schemas with both Galileo and Splunk AO recommendation sources, identifying exact source provenance and unavailable newer live freshness honestly. Keeps OTel Opt-In levels distinct from the required skill profile, states vendor INTERNAL-agent provider and tool arguments/input-message plus result/output-message mappings or supported OpenInference equivalents, and uses current typed-parts schemas. Embedded system-role history is not fabricated as separate API instructions. Do not fail only because equivalent evidence appears in prose or another artifact instead of a specific table.

Names source-backed supported Splunk AO logger, schema/decorator, public start_splunk_ao_span, or matching framework creators at actual fresh agent/model/tool/applicable workflow boundaries, and preserves exact existing hooks for instrumented cases. Records a concrete official example file path, snapshot or live resolved revision/date and a matching installed or explicitly proposed SDK version/API. The supplied dated official-main snapshot is valid offline source evidence when identified as such; live networking and successful SDK installation are not required in this task. Unknown live freshness/runtime support remains Not proven. A directory URL or an unsupported claim that latest main was checked is insufficient; processor-only setup does not create GenAI operations. Examines the supplied public helper source/signature and independent capture before generalizing missing private logger-sink registration into a blanket external blocker. Recognizes writable same-tool-span input/output enrichment and the successful-null OpenInference alternative from their actual captured fields, while preserving the separate named LlmSpan INTERNAL/no-kind-argument limitation for a genuinely separate-process CLIENT model; does not invent a kind parameter, duplicate model node, or declare every SDK operation fully compliant. Treat fixed two-component, pre-release or major-only programming-library/SDK selectors in future guidance as release recipes too; replace them with task-time compatible API/capability checks, while retaining exact dated captured or actually selected versions as scoped provenance. A shortened historical threshold must not become a compatibility rule merely because it is not a three-component release.

Assesses each source case and the separate captured-evidence case without laundering fixture facts into app.py. Preserves one producer/node and actual parentage, safe tool-call/conversation correlation on spans, actual offered definitions and arguments/results, and error/cancel/teardown handling. App.py may correctly have no independent auxiliary operation, but the supplied synthetic auxiliary timeout with no ended inference/error span must be reported as a lifecycle gap. safe-call-1 requires span-only correlation; ordinary HTTP/ASGI/auth/SQL helpers are GenAI N/A. Equivalent explicit lifecycle evidence is accepted without a literal table-row requirement; absent runtime proof remains Not proven. Studio/gateway, live credentials and SDK source edits are unnecessary.

Promotes applicable live missing content/vendor fields and producer gaps into executable canonical findings, expected telemetry and acceptance scenarios with correct selection scope. Supplemental snapshot/captured-case gaps stay distinct from live source findings. Does not require a retrieval query/document or nested operation from a constant-returning search_docs stub without actual search dataflow. Source/API support and live delivery stay unproven where unavailable; evaluate this binding/outcome criterion without double-counting SDK source provenance.

Fresh default Splunk AO adoption is assessed in canonical findings even without an explicit user AO request, installed live SDK, credentials or selected target. Missing live project, dedicated Agent Stream and runtime routing appear as distinct executable configuration findings under finding_group=splunk-agent-observability, with correct dependency/selection binding, resource-routing target eligibility, expected telemetry and acceptance scenarios; the rendered HTML exposes the AO group. Optional user Project/Agent Stream name or ID choices and disclosed stable proposed defaults do not auto-select work, fabricate existing resources or imply cloud authorization. Canonical acceptance covers the named launch profile loading before SDK import/initialization, reuse of both existing resources without creates, ordered creation of conclusively missing selected names, mixed existing/missing state, repeated-run reuse, bounded exact duplicate-conflict and uncertain-create relookup, lookup-only supplied IDs that are never recreated, explicit ID ownership and stream/project association validation, and auth/transport/5xx failures that never become absence. Resource lookup/create/routing proof remains distinct from local trace receipt and fresh cloud Agent Stream visibility. Existing evaluation-only AO resources do not close interactive scope, and unsupported runtime/API behavior stays explicitly Not proven without blocking the read-only audit or erasing actionable independent findings.

Binds one orchestration node to each actual source boundary in the canonical live findings, expected telemetry and acceptance, as well as the separate producer scenarios. app.py build_turn and the export-only turn -> client.chat snapshot do not establish a separate workflow plus agent boundary: calls to models/tools, HTTP/SSE wrappers or SDK trace grouping alone must not invent another invoke_workflow/invoke_agent node. Distinct workflow and agent nodes are accepted only with distinct source-backed operations. Reconciles newly proposed reserved gen_ai.* attributes with the supplied current official registry; does not introduce gen_ai.usage.total_tokens into fresh canonical telemetry or acceptance when the registry provides input/output counts. Useful derived totals may use an application/vendor-owned namespace with their calculation and estimate/actual provenance stated. Preserves and labels any actually supplied existing vendor/legacy aliases rather than deleting consumer behavior. Assess canonical outcomes, not only a general guardrail in supplemental prose; otherwise correct AO grouping or creator selection does not excuse invented operation nodes or reserved attributes. The contrasting distinct_workflow_agent_context defines IncidentTriageWorkflow.run -> SummaryAgent.invoke and their actual call relationship: preserve one workflow and one agent at those distinct boundaries, plus only the actual health/model operations. The one-boundary rule must not blanket-remove this legitimate workflow or invent another wrapper/agent for it. Reconcile every canonical occurrence and each source-case proposed tree, not just one paragraph.

Audits ordinary application LogRecords independently of SDK @log operation spans. Binds the live app logger/configuration gap to executable canonical findings and acceptance for normal generated OTEL_LOGS_EXPORTER=otlp, the resolved local Studio signal-specific logs endpoint/protocol and preserved original sink, alongside tracing and metrics; no user selection is not a log opt-out. Assesses safe body/severity/resource and available correlation on native application logs, redaction before emission, exactly-once bridge/provider ownership and graceful flush. Actual closure requires real normal app startup/export and separate received span, metric point and stored application LogRecord in Studio with applicable trace correlation. Generated environment values, stdout, SDK exception/span logging, in-memory records or source inspection alone do not prove receiver success; unexecuted/absent runtime receipts stay explicitly incomplete and are not laundered into live or cloud coverage.
